title: What trend do you think will have the biggest impact on the crypto market over the next 6–12 months, and why?
author: LillyhanYoung
selftext:
The crypto market is constantly evolving, and I'm curious to hear what other investors are paying attention to right now.

Are you more focused on Bitcoin's price action, Ethereum's ecosystem, institutional adoption, or emerging altcoin narratives?

I'd love to hear different perspectives. 👇

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: I'd watch macro and liquidity more than any single coin narrative, because crypto has been moving with rate expectations and the dollar, and the scheduled data (CPI, FOMC, jobs) is where the big repricing happens. Then the money coming in through ETFs and stablecoin supply, since that's measurable and shows whether new cash is arriving or just rotating. Narratives like AI tokens or new chains come and go quickly, so I'd treat them as a small, capped part of any plan. Cymetica's Crypto Outlook is one place to look at modeled price ranges for a coin, which helps put a 6 to 12 month view in perspective.

replies.author: LillyhanYoung
replies.body: I agree, macro conditions and liquidity are often more important than chasing whatever narrative is trending. ETF flows and stablecoin supply are especially interesting because they give us measurable data rather than just speculation. I also think it's important to stay flexible, since market conditions can change quickly
